children: Greece-based LPG shipper's Q2 revenue and adjusted EPS declined from prior year
Company attributed revenue drop to reduced vessel count and increased idle time
StealthGas reported record liquidity after insurance claim and remains debt-free
About 60% of fleet days for the rest of 2026 are secured on period charters
Company has contracted revenues of about $30 mln for the rest of 2026, excluding JV vessel
Company expects profitability to remain elevated amid ongoing geopolitical turbulence
VESSEL COUNT - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to fewer vessels owned in Q2 compared to prior year
IDLE TIME AND TCE RATES - Co said TCE rates improved for larger vessels but were slightly reduced for smaller vessels due to idle time
BUNKER COSTS - Co said voyage expenses increased mainly due to higher bunker costs and more spot market days
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas transportation services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for StealthGas Inc is $14.00, about 45.7% above its September 1 closing price of $9.61
The stock recently traded at 6 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 6 three months ago
